name: app-widget
title: App Widget
description: The rich, app-branded result card a connected tool hands back inline in chat: the same pattern ChatGPT's and Claude's app/MCP connectors use to render real UI instead of plain text. Every instance opens gated behind a real "Sign in to {app}" step: with an `app.loginUrl` set, clicking it genuinely opens that product's real login page in a new tab (Spotify's and Figma's own, here) before spring-morphing into a "Connecting…" spinner and the live result, and that connection genuinely persists across visits (`localStorage`, a rolling 30-day expiry), so it only re-gates after a month of disuse rather than every reload. In `mode="live"` the result is the product's own official iframe (demoed here with Spotify's and Figma's real, live embeds, not a recreation), resolving from a genuine shimmering skeleton via the iframe's own `onLoad`. For apps with no embeddable surface, the default demo mode renders a hand-built card instead, generalized past music with a `resultKind` prop, "audio" (Preview/Pause, a live equalizer) or "document" (Open/Opened, a checkmark badge), plus real thumbs and a header action (a Devices menu or a Copy-link button that morphs to a checkmark), picked per instance.
